Lancre, Pierre de

Paris, 1612 |


First edition, Comaissicned by Henri IV of France
to investigate reports of witches in Southern France,
de Lancre reported that the whole population of the Pays
de Labourd, 30,000 including all the priests, were
infected by witchcraft,

The TABLEAU is a xixx relation of the highlights of
de Lanere's activities as the trial judge in Labourd,
where he boasts of burning 600 victims. E
